fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: Optional section heading displayed above the calendar.

fields.name: apiBaseUrl
fields.label: API Base URL
fields.description: Laravel backend base URL. The block fetches events from /api/events?year=&month=.

fields.name: emptyMessage
fields.label: Empty Month Message
fields.description: Shown when there are no events in the displayed month.

fields.name: defaultView
fields.label: Default View
fields.description: Choose whether visitors first see the calendar or event table.

fields.name: tableHeading
fields.label: Table Heading
fields.description: Heading displayed above the table view.

fields.name: featuredCount
fields.label: Featured Event Count
fields.description: Number of event cards shown above the calendar/table. Use 0 to hide.
